value_comment: A juvenile detention center is a shorter term institution that provides care to children who require secure custody pending court adjudication, court disposition, or execution of a court order, or care to children after commitment
source_locator: wiki/reference/edfacts/2025-26/file-specifications/FS127-v22.1--edfacts-dg872-dg873-n-or-d-participation-lea-v221-fs127-22-1-112816.docx section=categories-and-permitted-valuesCategories and Permitted Values; pandoc table=9; body-row=3

value_comment: Revised! A shelter is a short-term facility operated specifically for delinquent children and youth that provides temporary care similar to that of a detention center, but in a physically unrestricting environment. The Department notes that it is unlikely that most shelters will meet the definition of an institution for delinquent children and youth.
source_locator: wiki/reference/edfacts/2025-26/file-specifications/FS127-v22.1--edfacts-dg872-dg873-n-or-d-participation-lea-v221-fs127-22-1-112816.docx section=categories-and-permitted-valuesCategories and Permitted Values; pandoc table=9; body-row=4

value_comment: Revised! A group home is a long-term facility, operated specifically for delinquent children and youth in which residents are allowed extensive contact with the community, such as attending school or holding a job. Includes halfway houses.
source_locator: wiki/reference/edfacts/2025-26/file-specifications/FS127-v22.1--edfacts-dg872-dg873-n-or-d-participation-lea-v221-fs127-22-1-112816.docx section=categories-and-permitted-valuesCategories and Permitted Values; pandoc table=9; body-row=5

value_comment: Revised! A ranch/wilderness camp is a long-term residential facility operated specifically for delinquent children and youth whose behavior does not necessitate the strict confinement of a long-term secure facility, often allowing them greater contact with the community. Includes ranches, forestry camps, wilderness or marine programs, or farms.
source_locator: wiki/reference/edfacts/2025-26/file-specifications/FS127-v22.1--edfacts-dg872-dg873-n-or-d-participation-lea-v221-fs127-22-1-112816.docx section=categories-and-permitted-valuesCategories and Permitted Values; pandoc table=9; body-row=6

The Department notes that it is unlikely that most treatment centers will meet the definition of an institution for delinquent children and youth.
